1.msg: Are there many land, shops, buildings, and real estate that are too difficult \rfor Blair to manage alone by any chance?\n\rCan I ease the burden a little? Give it to me please!

2.msg:
#i3801644#
Sure. Since I have too many. 
There's this Mysterious Hat Shop, can you take it? 
I don't know anything about magician or witch supplies.

3.msg: For real? I said that as a joke.\r\nBut, thank you! Blair! \nI'll manage it well. I got my own shop!

4.msg:
Haha, then #b#ho##k. 
Come back after equipping 
all of the #bMysterious Hat Shop Set#k that is essential to running the shop!
I'll prepare #i3018767# #t3018767# for you.
#r(You can only participate in this event once per world.)
